question: Which of the following is NOT a symptom of Beriberi caused due to the deficiency of Vitamin B1?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Slowly healing wounds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beriberi**

 
 
• Beriberi is caused due to the **deficiency of Vitamin B1** and sometimes it is also referred to as **thiamine deficiency**.
 
• The **two primary types** of beriberi are:
 
 
• **Wet beriberi**
 
• **Dry beriberi**
 
 
 
• The **circulatory and heart systems** are affected by **wet beriberi**. Wet beriberi can occasionally result in **cardiac failure**.
 
• **Dry beriberi harms the nerves**, which can result in **weakened muscles and ultimately muscle paralysis**.
 
• **Symptoms of wet beriberi:**
 
 
• rapid heart rate
 
• breath shortness during physical activity
 
• lower legs swelling
 
• Middle-of-the-night insomnia (MOTN)
 
 
 
• **Symptoms of dry beriberi:**
 
 
• Involuntary eye movement
 
• Difficulty speaking
 
• pain in the limbs
 
• paralysis
 
• vomiting​
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome** and beriberi are **associated **with each other as it is a kind of **brain injury due to thiamine deficiency**. 
 
• **Other causes of beriberi:**
 
 
• It is also commonly observed in those who **abuse alcohol**, which makes it **harder for body cells to absorb and store vitamin B1**.
 
• In extremely rare instances,** beriberi may also be a genetic condition** that is passed from **mother to child during breastfeeding**.
 
• **Hyperthyroidism**
 
 
 
• This disease can be **treated by restoring the blood cell level of thiamine **by increasing daily vitamin consumption.
 
• **Thiamine supplements** are administered** orally or intravenously** to treat patients (injection).
